Treatment is provided by a barminutor, extended aeration activated sludge tanks, a secondary clarifier and sludge drying beds.
Treated wastewater is disposed in four percolation ponds connected in parallel.
Sludge is periodically removed from the secondary clarifier to drying beds.
Dried sludge is disposed at the Benton Crossing Class III solid waste disposal site or an alternate authorized disposal site.
